source: TTC GTFS Realtime alerts, subway feed (https://gtfsrt.ttc.ca/alerts/subway)

alerts.header: Line 1 Yonge-University: There will be no subway service between Finch West and Wilson stations, starting 11:59 p.m., nightly Thursday, November 19 to Friday, November 20, due to planned track work. Shuttle buses will operate.
Line 2 Bloor-Danforth: No service between Jane and Keele stations due to a security incident at High Park station. Thank you for your patience.
alerts.description: All surface routes diverting away from High Park Station.
